verdict.rationale: Jan's docs say it can "Connect Jan with Claude Code, OpenClaw", and its local server exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints that such agent CLIs could be pointed at. There is no evidence of a single-command launcher that starts third-party agents pre-configured, so the integration appears to need manual endpoint configuration. Missing for 10: a documented single-command launch of agent CLIs, automatic pre-configuration to local models, a list of supported agents with setup docs, and hands-on corroboration.
